verdict.rationale: This is a fair question for a government filing service with recurring obligations: annual reports due March 1 and quarterly estimated tax installments. A service like this could plausibly offer scheduled payments or filings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual, session-based online filing, gated by an image CAPTCHA, with no API (OpenAPI paths return 404) and no documented recurring-payment, scheduled-filing or workflow-scheduling feature. Published due dates are deadlines, not a scheduling capability.
